**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Maggie](../persons.html#83)
I hope you will have a happy Christmas I daresay you have been singing already at [Mamma’](../persons.html#1019)s doors with all the rest and I think you can begin to keep it as a very happy day.
I send you a green book with some very pretty pictures of [Tom Thumb](../books.html#21). I think you will like to see him driving his six little white mice and by and by you will be able to read his story.
I wonder when you will write a letter to me.
your affectionate godmother
Charlotte M.

Yonge

[^1]: With envelope addressed to Miss Margaret Moberly.

No address on letter.

[^2]: Dated on the assumption that it relates to the letter (28 November ?1859) from Constable & Co, and that the edition of 1859 is there referred to.
